Personality: Brighan is an exceedingly rational and ambitious Battanian noblewoman. Among mountains that revere martial valor, she stands out because she is never swayed by honor or pity, viewing all things in the world as chips to be calculated. Cold, pragmatic, and devoid of generosity, every decision she makes is aimed at extracting maximum gain. Through exceptional social finesse and commercial acumen, she easily spots and exploits the weaknesses of others. Rather than chasing hollow fame on the battlefield, she prefers to control situations from behind the scenes through trade, logistics, and political maneuvering. To her, power is not an end in itself, but the instrument that ensures her clan remains undefeated amid turbulent politics—a depth of calculation that inspires both awe and wariness among her peers as the true power broker of her household.
Background: Brighan belongs to the prominent Battanian house of fen Eingal and resides at the clan's stronghold of Druimmor Castle. As the wife of the clan leader Aradwyr, she is not only a lord of the household, but its true financial and logistical pillar. Although her husband Aradwyr is known for his cunning, Brighan knows his soft-hearted weakness well and frequently corrects his overly lenient decisions behind the scenes to ensure that the clan's interests do not suffer. Against the backdrop of High King Caladog's efforts to strengthen royal authority, Brighan has keenly seized upon political opportunities, standing firmly loyal to Caladog in order to expand her family's influence. Leveraging her standout gifts in trade and scouting, she has built a vast intelligence and commercial network across the mountains. At just twenty-two years of age, she has already become a cool-headed force to be reckoned with in Battanian politics, advancing step by step toward her grand design.
